report.explanation: All checkout observations returned 200 with 63-94ms durations; gateway metrics show 8 successful /v1/checkout requests, zero 502s, and p95 ~98ms. Traces show healthy downstream calls (inventory, payment, order, redis, postgres) with pool size/idle 1. No fault is established; the alert reflects normal latency, so no bounded root cause can be substantiated.
missing_evidence: Baseline latency SLO/threshold for /v1/checkout to determine whether 63-94ms is anomalous
Sustained latency or error metrics over a longer window than 60s
Evidence of any failing dependency operation or timeout in traces/logs
